anchor_text: The pH scale is an indication of the hydrogen ion concentration and runs from below 0 to above 14.

anchor_text: Acidic solutions have a higher concentration of H⁺(aq) ions than OH⁻(aq) and have a pH below 7.
heading: Specification

anchor_text: Alkaline solutions have a higher concentration of OH⁻(aq) ions than H⁺(aq) ions and have a pH above 7.
